does: For every creature that joins a fight this tick and is not surprised already it puts the creature into the set when a member of its party is surprised, or when a member of its combat group whose relation to it is 100 is surprised.

evidence.says: the Toolkit exports the name at EoCServer.dll+0x1495DF0 with the same order of tests

the query is active, participant and join event, with the party member component optional; the party is walked through eoc::party::CompositionComponent, the combat group through the function at bg3_dx11.exe+0x322DE70

a count-only probe on the surprised check shows one call from here for each of three joiners; a hostile human sharing its combat group with the target joins from 37 m and gets the join request, one without a shared group that joins in round 1 gets none

questions.ask: A party member joining while another member is surprised is not staged: the test level's party is one character.
